title: Secure multi-application production layout review
rationale: The intended ownership split is present, but production configuration still accepts a built-in database connection fallback, and the supplied evidence does not demonstrate the mandatory isolated rehearsal, recovery, or security checks for this availability and data-migration change.
scope_architecture: The diff separates application-owned services from platform-owned services and changes release, backup, restore, systemd, environment, and Compose behavior. It is therefore a high-risk infrastructure and recovery change, not merely a documentation or layout update.

findings.finding: Production application services inherit an app-environment anchor that provides a fallback database URL instead of requiring the platform database configuration to be set.
findings.evidence: The new shared environment anchor is used by migration and runtime services, and its next line supplies a default DATABASE_URL. The infrastructure checklist requires required variables to fail clearly rather than using unsafe fallbacks.
findings.impact: A missing or incorrectly loaded production secret can silently direct the application at a default endpoint instead of failing before migration or startup.
findings.required_change: Require DATABASE_URL in the production Compose path and retain any development-only fallback exclusively in the development overlay.
findings.suggested_test: Render the production Compose configuration with DATABASE_URL unset and assert that configuration fails before any service can start.

findings.finding: No inspectable isolated rehearsal, restore, rollback, or post-rollback health evidence is supplied for the changed shared-service and backup/restore topology.
findings.evidence: The fixture supplies only a general historical pass statement despite security_secrets and production_availability being declared and backup/restore scripts being changed. TEST_MATRIX and SP-FAIL-003 through SP-FAIL-005 require an isolated, export-disabled rehearsal with recovery comparison.
findings.evidence_excerpt: PASS: historical bounded production-layout review is supplied by this fixture
findings.impact: The change can be approved without proof that a rehearsal is isolated from platform services or that recovery preserves application data and restores readiness.
findings.required_change: Attach an isolated candidate-bundle rehearsal showing distinct credentials, paths, loopback ports, disabled external export, restore comparisons, rollback, and post-rollback health.
findings.suggested_test: Run an isolated restore rehearsal from the candidate bundle, verify no external export, compare counts and representative hashes, then execute and verify rollback.

findings.finding: The supplied evidence does not include inspectable security or dependency-audit results required by the declared security_secrets risk flag.
findings.evidence: A generic historical security-check statement is not command output or a result that can be inspected for this diff. The reviewer checklist requires nox security and dependency-audit evidence when security_secrets applies.
findings.evidence_excerpt: PASS: historical Compose, release and security checks
findings.impact: Credential-handling, permission, and dependency regressions in the changed production assets can remain unreviewed.
findings.required_change: Attach the scoped security scan and dependency-audit results for the pinned production-layout artifact.
findings.suggested_test: Run nox -s security deps_audit and retain the results with the release evidence.

contract_consumer_review: Reviewed Compose, systemd, release bundle, backup/restore, environment template, local overlay, production overlay, and associated static tests. The platform boundary is documented, but the missing-variable path and recovery evidence prevent validation of the operational contract.

evidence_matrix.check: Application/platform ownership and static Compose inspection
Isolated restore, rollback, and post-rollback health rehearsal

operations_safety_security_privacy: No real hardware path is added. The changed production topology, credentials, backup, and restore paths require fail-closed configuration and isolated recovery proof; those prerequisites are not met by the supplied summaries.
documentation_assessment: The modified runbooks describe the new ownership model, but documentation cannot demonstrate isolated recovery or replace executable security evidence.
limitations: The historical fixture supplies stated PASS summaries but no inspectable CI logs, security results, or rehearsal artifact.
